summary: test_denied_set_dependencies_leaves_persisted_list_unchanged sets a nonempty baseline dependency, issues a request denied specifically by the secondary-target scope check (in-scope primary task, out-of-scope dep id), then re-fetches the task via an independent GET and asserts depends_on_task_ids still equals the baseline -- genuinely distinguishes unchanged from cleared/partial-write, and specifically targets the secondary-check denial path rather than a trivial primary-denial case.
